event.text: Fifty-five Christians were executed in Nagasaki during the Great Genna Martyrdom, part of persecution towards Christians in Japan by the Tokugawa shogunate.
event.page_extract: Nagasaki , officially Nagasaki City , is the capital and the largest city of Nagasaki Prefecture on the island of Kyushu in Japan.

title: The Folding of Fifty-Five Petals
artist_statement: I wanted to paint the weight of silence, not the noise of history. How belief becomes a body, and how the body becomes a memory held by the sea. In the stillness after the last breath, the harbor did not change, but something in the light was altered forever.
image_prompt: A dark, rain-slickened wooden dock at twilight on a wide bay, the water a deep gunmetal gray. In the foreground, a single oil lantern casts a warm, trembling glow on an abandoned wooden clogs and a torn piece of white cloth. Beyond, a row of five small fishing boats, their sails furled, are silhouetted against a pale, bruised sky. No figures. Only the creak of rope and the metallic smell of wet stone. The composition is anchored by the stark vertical of a distant church spire, its cross silhouetted, unlit.
